hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in */frontend/src/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" || exit 0; out=$(npm run -s lint 2>&1 && npx tsc -b 2>&1); status=$?;; */backend/src/*.java) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/backend" || exit 0; out=$(./gradlew -q compileJava compileTestJava 2>&1); status=$?;; *) exit 0;; esac; if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0
changed=$(git status --porcelain)
[ -z "$changed" ] && exit 0
fail=0
out=""
if echo "$changed" | grep -q "backend/"; then
  res=$(cd backend && ./gradlew -q test 2>&1) || { fail=1; out="$out
--- backend tests ---
$res"; }
fi
if echo "$changed" | grep -q "frontend/"; then
  res=$(cd frontend && npm run -s test:unit 2>&1) || { fail=1; out="$out
--- frontend tests ---
$res"; }
fi
if [ "$fail" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "$out" >&2
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
